elaine: quick note — onboarding orpheus-7b int4 hit a KV-cache ordering bug under long-prefill (~12k tokens). symptoms: repeated fragments, small grammatical shifts vs fp16. saw kv_write_index off by one in layers 8-11.
mike: which quant mode + runtime flags?
elaine: per-channel symmetric, clip=0.012, rotary_rescale=true (default). runtime kvcache=auto. sample log: 
L8 expected=12100 actual=12099
L9 expected=12100 actual=12099
Mismatch at token ~12102.
vik: hypothesis: fused int4 pack + rotary_rescale split path changes commit ordering for partial blocks. triggers nondeterministic writes.
elaine: forced rotary_rescale=false and reran short run -> alignment with fp16 through 13k. padding kvcache to 512-token blocks also fixed it.
mike: mitigation options: (1) pad to 512 (small memory reg), (2) disable rotary_rescale for int4 by default, (3) fix fused pack ordering in kernel.
elaine: opened incident INC-2026-0520. ops-bot: INC-2026-0520 created, severity=S3, assignee=eng-ml-oncall.
amanda: action items: add 14k longprefill regression to onboarding (elaine), add unit test for fused_kv_pack write-order (vik), temp config change to disable rotary_rescale on Dedicated int4 (ops), CI job with kvcache padding case (devex).
elaine: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4102 (adds checksum artifacts + job). vik: will attach micro-repro and bench.
elaine: tl;dr: ordering nondeterminism between int4 fused packing and rotary rescale -> KV write index skew. short-term: pad or disable rescale. long-term: kernel fix + regression tests. :white_check_mark:
